forecast_metadata.spatial_selection: Grid cell centers; no regridding or fractional-cell weighting
forecast_metadata.missing_data: Each mean renormalizes weights over finite SST and positive area
forecast_metadata.split_rule: Targets within split; validation/test initialization strictly after previous cutoff
forecast_metadata.index_definition: Monthly area-weighted Niño3.4 SSTA derived from saved SST on frozen model_mask
forecast_metadata.relative_index_definition: Niño3.4 SSTA minus separately forecast tropical SSTA; no official RONI scaling
forecast_metadata.persistence_definition: Full current SST anomaly held constant; add target-month training climatology
forecast_metadata.prediction_kind: CMIP simulation forecast; no observational forecast has been issued

field_metrics: All retained model_mask cells; true grid-cell areas; equal weight per target month
correlation: Pearson correlation across target months; undefined for constant series
skill: 1 - model_MSE / persistence_MSE; positive is improvement; undefined for zero baseline MSE
validation: Used for model selection; not an independent final score
test: Held out from all parameter selection; this script does not tune models
indices: Monthly indices from saved SST, using the training climatology and identical model_mask
example_map: Final test target month; chosen without searching for favorable forecast skill
